# bunnynet_loadbalancer (Resource)

This resource manages a Load Balancer in bunny.net.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bunnynet_loadbalancer" "test" {
  name            = "test"
  method          = "Latency"
  sticky_sessions = "Cookie"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the Load Balancer.

### Optional

- `method` (String) Options: `Geo`, `Latency`, `RoundRobin`, `Weight`
- `sticky_sessions` (String) Options: `Cookie`, `Off`

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique ID of the Load Balancer.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bunnynet_loadbalancer.test 123
```
